title: Mass File Encryption - High Entropy with No Ransom Note
id: 5a7d8e9f-0a1b-2c3d-4e5f-6a7b8c9d0e1f

description: Detects high-entropy file writes indicative of encryption, but excludes known legitimate tools and requires absence of ransom notes.

author: SOC Team

falsepositives:
    - Legitimate backup encryption tools (e.g., VeraCrypt, BitLocker)
level: medium

arguments.summary: A spear-phishing campaign led to a Cobalt Strike beacon execution on WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith. The initial access occurred via malicious PowerShell launched from Outlook, which executed an encoded command to load an unsigned DLL from the Temp directory using rundll32.exe. Network telemetry confirmed C2 beaconing to 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS. Despite detection by IDS (ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity), no containment actions were executed during the Admin phase due to misidentification of source IP (10.0.5.14 vs actual 10.0.5.42). The sandbox analysis returned a false negative ('limited_threat') due to abbreviated behavioral testing, missing critical post-exploitation activities including lateral movement, credential dumping, and persistence mechanisms. The incident represents a moderate to high risk with confirmed compromise and undetected lateral movement.

arguments.summary: A post-exploitation activity alert was triggered on host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) associated with user CORP\jsmith. Investigation revealed a Cobalt Strike beacon delivered via phishing email (Outlook), executed through encoded PowerShell, and launched an unsigned DLL from the Temp directory using rundll32.exe. The host communicated with a known C2 server (198.51.100.23) over HTTPS. Despite detection by IDS, response actions were denied due to policy or targeting issues. The malware sample 'taskeng_monitor.exe' (hash: e9f0a1b2...) exhibited limited behavior in sandboxing, but omitted events suggest broader malicious activity including credential dumping, lateral movement, and persistence mechanisms not fully captured. Critical response capabilities failed to execute, indicating a gap in incident containment readiness.
